snippet.title: NODE: PROTOCOL– Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the next evolution of hacking simulations. NODE: PROTOCOL is a deep-tech immersive sim that bridges the gap between signal physics and financial warfare.

Step into the shoes of a Neural Operator. Hunt 1,500 unique NPCs by tracking their mobile signals (IMSI), intercepting their 2FA codes, and draining their crypto wallets through authentic blockchain exploits.

THE EXPLOIT STACK:
SIGINT & Signal Decoupling: Use the Waterfall to intercept raw cellular traffic. Triangulate targets across 10 persistent cities and unmask IMSIs using real-world radio logic.

GTP-U Tunnel Injection: Perform data-plane MITM attacks. This isn't just "hacking"—it's a simulated Baseband overflow that gives you a 120-second window to snatch live MFA codes.

CVE-Based Arsenal: Deploy a library of 70+ authentic CVE exploits. From KERN-PANIC root-access to VOX_LINK voice interception, every tool has a specific thermal and power cost on your hardware.

Banking & Financial Heists: Breach secure banking portals by jacking active sessions. Manipulate the "Audit Trail" to delete transaction logs before the Feds trace your bounce-chain.

Live Blockchain Forensics: Every satoshi you steal is recorded on block_truth.io. Watch your "Taint" score rise in real-time and use Darknet Mixers to wash your funds before the Federal Taskforce clusters your identity.
